title: Fact supersession cosine threshold with production embeddings (explicit lane)

embed.role: primary: DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL for a keyed install

metrics.correction_miss_rate: correction, back-to-back and private correction probes with an active twin that were inserted beside the old value
metrics.restatement_miss_rate: restatements inserted beside the old value
metrics.coexisting_false_supersession_rate: new members of coexisting claims (next round, quarter, office, board date) that replaced or deduplicated another row
metrics.false_supersession_rate: all probes whose decision replaced or deduplicated a row of a different claim
metrics.preserved_distinct_share: claims ever established that still have an active row after the replay
metrics.correct_decision_rate: probes decided as the fixture expects

sources.threshold_pick_rule: guarded: lowest correction miss rate with false supersession <= 1% of probes and preserved distinct claims >= 99.5% (rrf_free arm); balanced: argmin(correction miss + coexisting false supersession). Rule fixed in the script before the production runs.
sources.product_parity: at 0.95 the real decideSingleFact runs beside the replayed rule and must agree

notes: Same fixture and replay as c2-interleave-dev, embedded through the product gateway with real provider models instead of a local model, swept over 18 thresholds for both candidate-fusion arms. Paid calls: two embedding passes of 1,506 short texts (about 23K tokens each). The threshold is not changed by this decision; the parent routes it.
